propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail with reducer-error, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets in the same relation graph.
Empty directories are invisible to git (git cannot track empty directories) and persist in local clones indefinitely, blocking plan reviews across entire epics.
The plan-relation reducer walks the store filesystem directory listing and errors on event-less entries rather than skipping them with a warning.

The fix is reader-side tolerance: skip event-less directories with a named warning instead of failing the snapshot; the writer continues creating ticket directories before first event to avoid concurrency race conditions.
This is not a transient failure and differs from prior git-visibility fixes (fa77, c083) which used .gitignore; those cannot apply here since git never sees empty directories.
